iboxs31_ltr303_init.tooltip: Initialize the onboard LTR-303 (I2C 0x29) with gain 1x and 100 ms integration; put it in setup

iboxs31_ltr303_gain.tooltip: Higher gain suits dim light but saturates in bright light; lux is corrected for the gain automatically

iboxs31_ltr303_integration.tooltip: How long each reading collects light; longer is more sensitive. The measurement period stays 500 ms and lux is corrected

iboxs31_ltr303_read.tooltip: Lux follows the application note formula; CH0 and CH1 are raw counts (the board_test card shows CH0). Reads within 0.1 s reuse the last result

iboxs31_ltr303_ok.tooltip: Whether the latest reading succeeded; on failure the last good values are kept
